# Dvergr lantern

Internal ID: Lantern | Type: One-handed | Source: Black forge, , Dvergr Buildings | Usage: Lightsource | Crafting Materials: Bronze x2, Surtling core x1, Crystal x1 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Dvergr lantern is a one-handed utility tool. It acts as a light source when equipped (similarly to a torch), only that it has no durability.

## Availability

• Sometimes found in Dvergr buildings, Infested Mines in the Mistlands or Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins in the Ashlands.
• Can be crafted at a Black forge.
• Can be taken from Dvergr buildings without becoming their enemy.

### Building

• Dvergr lantern pole
• Dvergr wall lantern

Categorias: Weapons, Light sources
